About INW

A meeting place for the Italian networking research community.

The 23rd Italian Networking Workshop will bring together researchers, PhD students and professionals to discuss ongoing work, exchange ideas and foster new collaborations in an informal setting.

INW 2027 is organized by the University of Rome Tor Vergata.

Save the date.
The website, registration procedure and call for contributions will be announced shortly.

Workshop venue

Hotel Carlo Magno

The workshop will take place in Madonna di Campiglio, Trentino, from 19 to 21 January 2027.

Detailed information about the meeting rooms, accommodation and travel will follow.
